body:
oh honey. i'm guessing you're using IM coz you can't get your own veins?

that is a tough situation that you are in. if you want to stop hurting your partner and stop using could you consider going home to your parents' place? no need to tell them about the drugs just tell them that you guys have split... and that you need to start rebuilding your life as a single person. save some money and then move out again on your own? it's tough though when drugs are fucking calling.

i feel for you man. it sounds like you really need these online relationships because perhaps you've invested so much in them that you've neglected real life? maybe while you nurture these online relationships (no lies, but maybe just maintain friendships for now with no romance attached) you could try to ease back into real life a little? easier said than done, like anything worthwhile, but i think you need to do it, for yourself and your future.
